Package neqsim.process.safety.release

package neqsim.process.safety.release
Source term generation for consequence modeling.

This package provides tools for calculating release source terms for QRA consequence analysis:

  • LeakModel - Mass flow, jet velocity, and momentum calculations
  • SourceTermResult - Time-series release data with export capabilities
  • ReleaseOrientation - Jet orientation for dispersion modeling
  • ReleaseSolidRiskAssessment - Fail-closed mixture-specific solid and hydrate applicability assessment

The source terms can be exported in formats compatible with consequence modeling tools:

  • PHAST (DNV)
  • FLACS (Gexcon)
  • KFX (DNV)
  • OpenFOAM

LeakModel time integration is limited to a rigid, adiabatic, well-mixed gas inventory. It conserves component mass and energy and fails explicitly if condensation occurs. The scalar release correlations remain screening methods. The homogeneous-equilibrium model assesses its resolved stations for equilibrium solids and hydrate risk, but does not calculate solid-bearing release flow.

Example usage: 

 SystemInterface gas = new SystemSrkEos(300.0, 50.0);
 gas.addComponent("methane", 1.0);
 gas.setMixingRule("classic");
 gas.init(0);
 gas.init(1);

 LeakModel leak = LeakModel.builder().fluid(gas).holeDiameter(0.025) // 25mm hole
     .vesselVolume(10.0) // 10 m³
     .scenarioName("HP Separator Leak").build();

 SourceTermResult result = leak.calculateSourceTerm(300.0, 1.0); // 5 minutes
 double peakFlowKgS = result.getPeakMassFlowRate();
 double totalReleasedKg = result.getTotalMassReleased();
